dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Kid? What kid? Wait... You're not talking about Tribunus Mettius, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Giovanni
dialogues.text: Shh, keep your voice down, or he'll hear you! Of course, Dominus Cassiodor has said that we should not whip our soldiers, but if the Tribunus hears you, things will get ugly all the same...
